note: BH-10199 (slice 1): settings row lane.pr-state-reconcile.gh_source_issues. Where the held fact reads a PR's comment thread (hold_check_thread, bin/lib/hold.sh): off = GitHub only (today's reads); shadow (default) = the issue record and GitHub, the sweep acts on GitHub, logs one PRR_SHADOW line (key <repo>#<n>@comments) in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ, and writes GitHub's answer back into the record; record = the issue record (bin/lib/issue-record.sh), 0 GitHub calls on a hit, and a miss reads GitHub, logs PRR_MISS and writes the answer back. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. The lane's GH_SOURCE step off makes this off too (off = no record read at all). Separate from GH_SOURCE (the open list and closed state reads). Move to record only after a 48-hour shadow count of 0 (docs/notes/2026-11-27-BH-10199-issue-record.md).
